hero.label: Case study
hero.title: Crédit Agricole Technologies & Services: certifying the efficiency of web and mobile applications
hero.subtitle: Crédit Agricole Technologies & Services set up an internal measurement and labelling approach to improve efficiency, performance and the environmental impact of its digital products.

intro.title: Measuring efficiency to prioritise the most impactful actions
paragraphs: The Digital Front Chapter at Crédit Agricole Technologies & Services develops applications for employees and 8 million customers.
The goal was therefore to better measure application behaviour to prioritise the most impactful actions.
list: dissatisfied users because some applications were too slow;
data volumes too high for branch network infrastructure;
environmental responsibility to integrate into the product approach.

image.alt: Smart'Use approach illustration at Crédit Agricole Technologies & Services

results.title: An internal Smart'Use label to assess and improve products
items: Web and mobile products are assessed and labelled through an internal efficiency label.
Progress is encouraged through healthy competition between teams.
Teams have concrete results to identify priority improvement levers.

items.title: Co-built labelling criteria
items.text: The criteria for the internal efficiency label « Smart'Use » were co-built then rolled out to Tribes.

items.title: A managed services model
items.text: Audits are performed on demand, in a managed services logic suited to team needs.

items.title: Direct access to results
items.text: Squads access Greenspector Studio to view their results, track indicators and identify actions to take.

items.title: A continuous improvement dynamic
items.text: The approach stimulates competition between teams and encourages continuous progress on web and mobile products.

testimonial.title: Julien Azria speaks
quotes: « The solution provides very concrete results on the behaviour of our applications. This allows us to focus on the most impactful actions. Working on efficiency clearly leads to a more performant application. »
testimonial.author: Julien Azria
